standard: Radar track table and operator logs as exported by a port vessel traffic service (no single public standard; column names are plain)
notes: All times UTC with a Z suffix. Vessels are joined by MMSI to 06_data_streams/vessels.json, berths to terminal_registry.json. Sensors are described in sensors.csv in the same folder.

sensors.description: The sensors and where they are.

fields.name: sensor_type
fields.notes: radar buoy, fixed camera, vessel traffic log

fields.name: name
fields.example: Buoy-NE, entrance channel off the Port Aransas jetties

fields.name: latitude
fields.notes: Sensor position; blank for the traffic log

radar_tracks.description: Radar plots, one row per plot, one file per month.

fields.name: track_id
fields.notes: Tracker's own number for the contact; a contact lost and picked up again gets a new one

fields.name: latitude
fields.notes: WGS-84; a few metres of plot noise

fields.name: range_nm
fields.notes: Range from the buoy, nautical miles

fields.name: bearing_deg
fields.notes: Bearing from the buoy, degrees true

fields.name: est_length_m
fields.notes: Length estimated from the echo, metres

fields.name: size_class
fields.notes: ship (50 m and over) or small

fields.name: ais_correlated
fields.notes: Y if the tracker matched the plot to an AIS report received at the same time, N if not

fields.name: correlated_mmsi
fields.notes: MMSI of the matched AIS report (vessels.json); blank when ais_correlated is N

fields.name: ingest_utc
fields.notes: When the plot reached the shore archive, UTC

fields.name: event_type
fields.notes: FRAME routine summary of what is in view; PASSAGE vessel passing the camera; BERTH ARRIVAL, BERTH DEPARTURE; INCIDENT operator entry

fields.name: mmsi
fields.notes: MMSI where the operator or analytics identified the vessel (vessels.json); blank if unidentified

fields.name: vessel_name
fields.notes: Name read or matched; blank if unidentified

fields.name: est_length_m
fields.notes: Length estimated from the image, metres

fields.name: vessels_in_view
fields.notes: What is at the berths in view

fields.name: water_surface
fields.notes: Operator's description of the water surface

vessel_traffic_log.description: Checkpoint passages with pilot and tug assignments.

fields.name: pilot_order_id
fields.notes: Pilot order number for piloted movements

fields.name: time_utc
fields.notes: UTC; hourly, plus a row at each change

fields.name: status
fields.notes: ONLINE, OFFLINE, NO UPLINK (recording on board, link down), BUFFER RECOVERED, ARCHIVE EXPORT

fields.name: detail
fields.notes: Fault or restoration detail as logged

scenario_notes.coverage: 2027-08-15T00:00Z to 2028-01-12T06:00Z, less the periods a sensor was out of service.
scenario_notes.cadence: Radar plots about every 2 minutes while a contact is held (more often through bends, every 30 minutes for a stationary contact); camera frame summaries every few hours and event rows as they occur; status hourly.
scenario_notes.geography: Radar plots pass scripts/check_geo.py rule "vessel"; cameras are on land, radar buoys in the water (99_reference/geo/position_rules.d/maritime.json).
